title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Women’s Rights Programme in Nepal, implemented by ActionAid and local partners aims to create cultural shifts in attitudes and behaviours in support of women's rights. The main objective is to work with government and other power holders at the local and national level to take action that protect, promote and respect women's rights through attitude and behaviour change both in their policy decisions, representation in different platforms and inclusion of women in decision making processes. Objective: Duty bearers and service providers, actively demonstrate those essential and progressive behaviours /actions that are necessary to empower women economically, safeguard and promote women’s rights. (Cultural shift and change in attitude if key stakeholders) Outcome: Crosscutting outcome - Attitudes and behaviours (at all levels) are supportive of women accessing rights and opportunities
